summary: Brushed DC planetary gear motor with an encoder: a cylindrical body with an 8mm REX output shaft that protrudes from the gearbox face. The drawings label the 80mm as shaft length, and the catalog entry's 'length: 80' appears to refer to the same thing. Body bounds are an estimate, with the axis along z and the body centered on the origin.

mountingSurfaces.description: Output-end gearbox face, flat and perpendicular to the shaft. The 8mm REX shaft extends 80mm from it, so it can pass through a 1120 U-channel wall and still leave room for a hub and wheel (Insight #8).
Rear (encoder) end face, perpendicular to the shaft axis.

notes: The images print only the 80mm shaft length and the 8mm REX shaft size. The 80mm shaft extends beyond the body envelope above, which excludes it. The 37mm body diameter and 105mm body length are my estimates and are not printed or dimensioned in the drawings. The gearbox screw-hole pattern, channel hole sizes and positions, and body diameter are not dimensioned, so no holes are listed. The shaft's M4 tapped end hole is visible but not sized. Verify the body dimensions against the vendor datasheet before use.
